segments.text: I just got three different tests done that finally confirmed I have endometriosis, all of them without surgery. Now, most women go between 7 to 10 years without diagnosis. So, in the last 42 days, we sprinted to try and get me a diagnosis. 33 million of you saw this tweet where I was getting a transvaginal ultrasound with my boyfriend Bryan Johnson watching. We did this [music] to try and confirm I had endometriosis. This particular test came back clear. We were able to get retested

and I now have a confirmed endometriosis diagnosis. We also were able [music] to get two other diagnoses for my endometriosis using non-surgical tests. So, this is a really amazing playbook for any female out there. If you also have suspected endometriosis, there are other options for you other than surgery. Now, we're going to go even further and try to actually treat my endometriosis without doing surgery as well.
